harness_api.quote: Use humanlayer automation run to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server.
harness_api.note: First-party control plane for harnesses on your hosts: app.humanlayer.com (web/mobile/desktop) creates sessions on a chosen daemon host, streams session events and sends follow-up messages; the CLI (`humanlayer automation run --pat ... --prompt/--prompt-file --coding-agent --model`) starts a prompted session headlessly and lets you follow up from Cloud. Harnesses: Claude Code (Claude Agent SDK), Codex, plus HumanLayer's own Fold agent (preview). The HumanLayer API itself is not documented as a public REST API/SDK; the documented programmatic surface is the CLI. It drives agents on your own machines, not provider sandboxes.

egress_allowlist.quote: The daemon gives coding agents the file and network access of the user that runs it. Use an account with only the access that the sessions need.
egress_allowlist.note: No provider-side network controls; you restrict the host yourself.

egress_http_rules.quote: The daemon gives coding agents the file and network access of the user that runs it.
egress_http_rules.note: No provider-side egress layer at all (BYO compute).

secret_proxy.quote: The coding agent also needs its provider credential in the environment — ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for the default Claude setup.
secret_proxy.note: BYOK: model keys/subscriptions live on the daemon host (env vars, `claude /login`), workspace config copies .env files into worktrees; no injecting proxy.
